text: {"question": "What is sustained low-efficiency dialysis (SLED) considered as an alternative for critically ill patients with acute kidney injury?", "answer": "Sustained low-efficiency dialysis (SLED) is considered a cost-effective alternative to continuous renal replacement therapy (CRRT) in critically ill patients with acute kidney injury (AKI).", "evidence": "Sustained low-efficiency dialysis (SLED) is a cost-effective alternative to continuous renal replacement therapy (CRRT) in critically ill AKI patients."}
